Commands:
  init <NAME>                     Create a new environment
  up                              Provision the environment
  down                            Tear down the environment
  import                          Import files
    <FILE> (required) - Data files (.png, .csv) to import
  report                          Report commands
    upload                        Upload report files to the test's documents
      <FILE> (required) - Markdown files (.md) to upload
  status                          Show the environment status
